text_blocks.snippet: Long COVID treatment focuses on managing individual symptoms, as a specific cure is still under investigation. Treatment options include medication for symptoms like cough, headaches, and mental health issues, as well as therapies like physical and pulmonary rehabilitation. Stellate ganglion block and olfactory retraining may also be considered according to Cleveland Clinic. Counseling is also a part of the treatment approach according to Cleveland Clinic.
